title: curvo real-data demonstration
single_claim: curvo infers membrane-mechanical parameters and mechanism from CME curvature trajectories with calibrated uncertainty and an identifiability firewall that refuses underdetermined force claims.

observable_ladder.1_intensity: coat-assembly proxy (any TIRF); NOT curvature; force refused
observable_ladder.2_epitirf_depth: invagination/axial depth; curvature proxy; needs registered epi+TIRF
observable_ladder.3_superres_curvature: curvature in real time (SIM/super-res); the inverse's real input

iav_2022_membranes.role: REJECTED for depth — tirf/epi not registered same-field (r=0.02)
iav_2022_membranes.source: user's own raw data (/root/projects), single-timepoint OME-TIFF

biotisr_ccp.source: public: BioTISR 2D Data (CCPs), live-cell TIRF-SIM; collection tied to the DPA-TISR paper, Nat Biotech 2025

tension_crosscheck.verdict: consistent with the 2020 finding (tension impedes maturation)

superres_extraction.maturation: R_proj falls 106->39 nm start-to-end (non-monotonic frame-to-frame); H_proxy rises 0.0094->0.025 /nm — overall flat->dome->Omega direction

real_inverse.verdict: force UNDETERMINED — geometry-only proxy, actin not co-imaged; firewall refuses point force
real_inverse.disambiguating_experiment: co-image actin (dual-color TIRF-SIM) or provide absolute curvature calibration

honest_caveats: Most public CME imaging is observable #1 (intensity/lifetime), which is a coat-assembly proxy and cannot support force inference — curvo refuses it at the data boundary.
Actin is rarely co-imaged with CCP super-res; without the actin channel the geometry-only inverse cannot break the c_eff/force degeneracy, so cortical force is UNDETERMINED.
CCS force-inference has NOT been validated on real force ground truth. The only real force-paired validation (tether/STED, mean|bias| 3.8%) is tube geometry, not a coated pit.

The super-res curvature signal is a projected coat-footprint radius (1/R_proj), a proxy whose absolute 3D scale depends on an ASSUMED pixel size (31.3 nm/px), not read from the file header nor verified against the acquisition paper in this build.
The IAV epi-TIRF data could not yield depth: tirf/epi images are not registered same-field pairs (punctum correlation r=0.02). Registered epi-TIRF or a z-stack would be needed.
Raw imaging is never committed — the repo records provenance (DOIs, paths, retrieval dates) only.
what_the_demonstration_shows: End-to-end: real cmeAnalysis cohorts reproduce the 2020 tension-impedes-maturation finding (front-end, #1); real super-res CCP movies yield genuine curvature trajectories (#3); the inverse fits their shape but its identifiability firewall correctly refuses a force number from geometry alone — the same discipline that makes curvo trustworthy, demonstrated on real data.
